# Pull request

## Linked issue

Closes #

## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and the implementation boundary affected.

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. Include the operating system and display scale for native verification.

- [ ] Relevant success, failure, and boundary tests were added or updated.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant race, native, or security checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and `AGENTS.md` were updated where behavior or guidance changed.
- [ ] New dependencies and third-party assets have compatible licenses and notices.
- [ ] No unrelated changes, credentials, local configuration, or build output are included.

## UI evidence

Attach real before/after screenshots when applicable. State explicitly when the change has no visual effect.

## Risks and limitations

Describe source compatibility, privacy, security, migration, or known unresolved limitations.
